summary_1line: Rama tells Queen Kaushalya of his exile; she collapses in grief and laments the fate that will leave her powerless in the palace.

image_candidates.scene_text: Queen Kaushalya collapses to the ground like a severed tree branch after Rama tells her he must leave for fourteen years of exile.
Rama gently lifts his dust-covered mother from the floor and brushes the dirt from her body while Lakshmana stands nearby in anguish.
Kaushalya in white robes offers oblations into a sacred fire at dawn, surrounded by ritual vessels and garlands before Rama enters.
